headline: Operations analyst who builds reporting that small teams actually use
narrative: I spent six years turning messy spreadsheets into dependable weekly reports for a regional bakery chain and a small clinic network. I like plain tools and clear handoffs.
resume_text: Operations analyst, Harbor Loaf Bakeries and Pine Row Clinics. Built weekly reports in spreadsheets and a small database. Cut month-end close from 9 days to 5 days. Trained 14 shift leads on the new dashboards.

proof_points.evidence: Rebuilt the reconciliation sheets and the checklist for Harbor Loaf Bakeries

proof_points.claim: Trained shift leads on new dashboards
proof_points.evidence: Ran short sessions at each Harbor Loaf Bakeries site

proof_points.claim: Found and reduced recurring supply waste
proof_points.evidence: Compared deliveries with sales for Pine Row Clinics

variants: Built weekly operations reports from three data sources for 11 sites.
Wrote one-page handoff guides so new staff could run the reports alone.

evaluation.Biggest gap: No direct experience with the posting's named warehouse software
